title: Harnessing rare earth coordination chemistry for advanced photofunctional materials: from fundamental principles to emerging technologies
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2026, 55,5117-5197
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS00384A, Review Article
Fu-Jia Song, Pingru Su, Xue Li, Chun-Hua Yan, Jun-Long Zhang, Yu Tang
Harnessing RE coordination chemistry, antenna effects, and ligand engineering, this review establishes ligand–RE3+ structure–property correlations, outlines photofunctional strategies, and bridges fundamentals to emerging technologies.
